# Platå

Platå is an open-source, static Danish A2-B2 learning product and source-backed lesson factory.

Live product: https://lamapony.github.io/plata-trainers/
Source repository: https://github.com/lamapony/plata-trainers

For an agent asked to create a lesson:
1. Clone or open the source repository with write and command access.
2. Read AGENTS.md and docs/AGENT_LESSON_WORKFLOW.md.
3. Extract a topic, concrete learner goal, real pressure situation, level, and constraints from the user's normal-language request. Do not ask the user for JSON.
4. Preview assumptions without writing: npm run lesson:new -- --topic "..." --goal "..." --situation "..." --preview
5. Re-run the same command without --preview to persist the normalized plata.lesson-request contract and scaffold.
6. Author source-backed Danish content and complete lesson-request.json.delivery.
7. Preview optional Danish audio without provider calls: npm run generate:lesson-audio -- --lesson <slug> --dry-run
8. Read docs/AUDIO_PIPELINE.md before any authorized synthesis; human listening approval is required for publication.
9. Run: npm run lesson:verify -- --lesson <slug>
10. Run the full npm run check before calling the lesson publishable.

For a saved reproducible brief, use: npm run lesson:new -- --request <request.json> --preview

The live Pages site is read-only. It does not embed an autonomous model and cannot create or publish lesson files by itself.
